title: Setup metadata object designer: a locked object's canvas accepts Add field / move / remove section, shows "Unsaved" and offers no Save — the work is dropped silently
body:
Filing gate **① a product defect with a reproduction**. Found by the HotCRM full browser pass objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320 on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0: track 6 Studio (report comment 6443071470 on objectstack-ai/hotcrm#2320, finding D2; screenshots on branch `claude/project-thread-ozavxm` under `qa/` and in the HotCRM project files `qa-2320/6-studio/`). Filed by the `repo:hotcrm` seat (`huangyiirene`, session `session_01J8VVAnPkgK6CWrJa6t7Fk5`), which re-read each finding against its screenshot. Batch-of: hotcrm#2320 platform findings.

`finding` class **a** · `reach:` public door: the console on `@objectstack/*` 18.2.0, measured in Chromium against the HotCRM seed.

## What is seen

Setup › All Metadata Types › Object › `crm_account`. The banner says "This item is locked and cannot be edited or deleted. app.objectstack.hotcrm@6.0.0". Still: **Add field** → **Text** appends a field "Text" (`text`) to Ungrouped and the inspector shows an **Unsaved** chip; no Save button exists on the page and no request is sent; leaving drops the work without a word. "Add field to this section", "Move section up / down" and "Remove section" are live on every section (`g-setup-meta-crm_account.png`, `g-add-field-click.png`, `g-add-field-text-added.png`).

**Who loses:** an admin who believes they changed a packaged object.

## Expected

As the banner says: on a locked item the canvas's add / move / remove controls and the Description box are disabled (read-only, as the inspector inputs already are elsewhere).

## Dedupe

`search_issues` objectstack "locked metadata item object designer add field editable no save": 5 hits — #24677, #24547, #23119, #3257, #7529 (all closed, other metadata doors). None reports this.

**Reader who acts:** the Setup metadata object designer owner (`domain:ui`).
